content.text: PROFILERory McIlroyAthlete, Golf$84M2025 The World's Highest-Paid Golfers Earningsas of 6/11/25Photo by Mike Ehrmann/Getty ImagesFrom the EditorLast Updated Jun 11, 2025, 1:01am EDTMcIlroy is one of the PGA Tour's most marketable players, now matching Tiger Woods with his earnings off the course, according to Forbes estimates.McIlroy is also the only PGA Tour player other than Woods to have won at least $100 million in career prize money.He completed the career Grand Slam in 2025 with a win at the Masters, claiming his fifth victory at a major and his first in more than a decade.McIlroy and Woods announced in 2022 that they had founded TMRW Sports, a tech-focused venture that subsequently launched a new golf league called TGL in 2025.McIlroy returned to No. 1 in the World Golf Ranking in February 2020, four years after his last time on top.
